title: Explore extracted tilemaps and rectangles
changes: Decode documented tilemap runs, streams and rectangles into an interactive cell explorer with optional manually selected graphics and palette.
Show raw cell values and interpreted tile, flip and palette fields, label unavailable tiles and avoid claiming an original scene or palette pairing.
validation: Synthetic unit rom-data-viewer-tilemaps-uyjmm_og checked decoding, wrapping, invalid tokens, color and flip pixels, cell inspection and the viewer generator suite in Linux Chrome.

Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-tilemaps-eur-corrected-gmofczjl compared all 2224 cells across eight maps and eleven rectangles against an independent source reconstruction and checked a graphics/palette pixel and navigation. Initial tuysj7hm stopped because its comparison did not allow the expected resource-status change.
limitations: Graphics and palettes are manually paired, palette IDs are not automatically applied and missing tiles are shown in magenta. The paused large-JSON prototype remains excluded from the local page; Windows is deferred.
